questions.question: What explains the fall in Aviva's commercial lines premiums over the first nine months, even as group premiums rose?
options: The loss of commercial clients after the Direct Line deal
A deliberate withdrawal from UK and Ireland commercial business
Softer market conditions in the commercial insurance market
Higher reinsurance costs that reduced written premiums
questions.explanation: Commercial premiums fell because of softer market conditions, while the Direct Line deal drove growth in personal lines.
questions.headline: Aviva premiums surge as Direct Line takeover drives growth

questions.question: What is the stated purpose of the IUAI's new Reinsurance and Data Study Group?
options: To develop aviation statistics and data and educate members on reinsurance concepts
To set minimum capital standards for aerospace reinsurers
To produce annual loss rankings for aerospace insurers
To negotiate shared reinsurance treaties on behalf of members
questions.explanation: The group exists to build aviation data and teach members how reinsurance works in aerospace insurance.
questions.headline: IUAI to strengthen industry knowledge and expertise with Reinsurance and Data Study Group

questions.question: What does the Microsoft outage's impact on banks, courts and AI services illustrate?
options: That the infrastructure behind business and AI is concentrated in few providers
That cyber attacks are now the main cause of cloud failures
That regulators have failed to require backup systems at banks
That AI services are less reliable than traditional software
questions.explanation: A single failure at one provider hit many sectors, showing how concentrated the underlying infrastructure is.
questions.headline: Microsoft struggling to restore Outlook and Teams after global outage

questions.question: What do Cerebras's new cloud partnerships and the share price reaction suggest, according to the brief?
options: Investors expect AI spending to slow in the coming year
Cloud providers are abandoning their in-house chips
Investors see demand for alternative AI compute suppliers
Cerebras has overtaken the leading chipmaker in revenue
questions.explanation: Cloud providers signing on and the market rewarding Cerebras point to investor belief in demand for alternative AI compute.

questions.question: Why is the Federal Reserve Board's announcement on payment services pricing described as bearing on bank costs rather than markets directly?
options: It takes effect too far in the future to influence markets
It sets the interest rate banks earn on reserves
It is operational pricing for bank services, not a change in rates or monetary policy
It only applies to credit unions and not to banks
questions.explanation: The announcement concerns pricing of services, not interest rates or monetary policy, so its effect is on bank costs.
questions.headline: Federal Reserve Board announces pricing, effective January 1, 2027, for payment services the Federal Reserve Banks provide to banks and credit unions, and changes to streamline and adjust their check services

questions.question: Why does the departure of Nvidia's chief executive matter beyond Nvidia itself?
options: It forces other chipmakers to replace their own leadership
It shows one company's problems can shift sentiment across a whole sector
It signals that chip demand from China is collapsing
It triggers automatic index rebalancing across technology funds
questions.explanation: A leadership shock at the most valuable chipmaker is dragging on tech shares more broadly.
questions.headline: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks fall; tech slumps after Jensen Huang Nvidia exit

questions.question: What did Volodymyr Zelenskyy say Europe needs to do regarding peace negotiations with Russia?
options: Send a delegation from each member state to the talks
Hold a separate summit with Vladimir Putin
Increase military aid before talks begin
Choose a single representative, ideally by the end of this month
questions.explanation: Zelenskyy wants Europe to speak through one representative, ideally chosen by month end.

questions.question: Why does European involvement in the Russia-Ukraine talks matter, according to the brief?
options: It could shape the terms of a settlement and ties Ukraine's security outcome to its EU path
It commits the EU to immediate Ukrainian membership
It removes the US from the negotiating process
It guarantees a ceasefire will be signed this year
questions.explanation: Europe's role could influence settlement terms and links Ukraine's security outcome with its EU membership path.
questions.headline: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks

questions.question: What has Jensen Huang been summoned to testify before Congress about?
options: Nvidia's market dominance in AI chips
Nvidia's export of chips to China
Insider share sales ahead of his resignation
An affair with an alleged Chinese spy
questions.explanation: The congressional summons concerns his affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
questions.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy

questions.question: Why does the brief say the full nature of Megaspeed's links to Nvidia's chief remains unclear?
options: Nvidia has denied any connection to the company
Singapore law keeps the firm's ownership records sealed
Little is known about the firm, with a thin footprint and staff who know nothing about it
Megaspeed has refused all requests for comment
questions.explanation: The firm has proved hard to pin down, with a sparse footprint, so its links to Nvidia's chief remain unclear.
questions.headline: A baffling trail from Australia to Singapore: what is Megaspeed, the company implicated in downfall of Nvidia’s Jensen Huang?

questions.question: In the put option hedge on a tech-heavy portfolio, what happens if tech shares recover or hold steady?
options: The put gains value and offsets gains on the shares
The hedge costs money and the protection expires worthless
The investor receives the premium back at expiry
The investor is forced to sell the underlying shares
questions.explanation: Without a fall in tech shares, the premium paid is lost and the protection expires worthless.
questions.headline: Protecting a tech-heavy portfolio with put options
